display_long_description:
ZOMBIE OUTBREAK VR is a high-intensity VR shooter designed exclusively for Meta Quest.
Your mission is simple: protect the core zone and survive at all costs.

You are deployed into a ruined facility overrun by infected creatures. There is no escape route. No backup. Just you, your weapons, and the enemies closing in from every direction.

🔫 REALISTIC GUNPLAY IN VR

Experience true weapon handling with manual reloading, responsive aiming, and immersive recoil. Every shot feels physical. Every reload matters.

🧟 WAVE-BASED SURVIVAL

Survive increasingly dangerous waves of infected enemies. Each round brings faster, tougher zombies with unpredictable behavior.

🎯 DEFEND ONE CRITICAL AREA

This is not a run-and-gun shooter.
Positioning, timing, and accuracy are key. If the zone falls, humanity follows.

🌆 IMMERSIVE ATMOSPHERE

Fight through devastated industrial zones and urban ruins with cinematic lighting and intense sound design that brings every moment to life.

⚡ OPTIMIZED FOR META QUEST

Built and optimized for smooth performance on Meta Quest platforms.

If you enjoy intense action, realistic gunplay, and survival pressure —
ZOMBIE OUTBREAK VR is your next mission.
